question: Should ClawHub land this Official/profile-state label vocabulary in this PR now, or wait to consolidate it with adjacent feed and publisher-state work?
rationale: The branch adds durable spec language for trust and discovery labels, so automation cannot choose the long-term vocabulary even though the code patch is narrow.

options.title: Accept narrow vocabulary now
options.body: Proceed after real browser proof if maintainers want these labels to be the current product direction while later feed slices fill in missing facts.

options.title: Consolidate with adjacent feed work
options.body: Keep the draft open until the related account and publisher feed stack settles the public vocabulary together.

options.title: Limit to UI copy only
options.body: Ask the contributor to narrow or drop the durable spec additions and keep this branch focused on the current Official wording and profile labels.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow vocabulary now
